  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  March 12, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st
Floor. On March 12, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on February 26, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Daniel Medina on behalf of the City Of Inglewood to host an Easter Eggstravaganza Event
  at 700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr. Park- grassy area near baseball fields, Public
  Property, on Saturday, March 21, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject to
  Parks and Rec approval for use of the park; IPD will deploy one (1) sgt and two (2) police
  officers for public safety and four (4) CH security officers to assist any potential crowd
  control and monitor restrooms used by attendees to mitigate any outside lewd conduct
  activity; None conditons for Code Approval; None conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain
  site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event;
  Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective
  personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426709)
 Permits & License Committee  March 12, 2026
Minutes  Page 2 of 6

Item #2:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host a Crenshaw Capital Improvement
  Project Ribbon Cutting Ceremony (Phase I) Event at 2810 W Imperial Hwy, Private
  Property; on Saturday, March 28, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event within Crenshaw Imperial Plaza parking
  lot; IPD will staff two (2) police officers for public safety and two (2) TCO’s for traffic control
  (ingress / egress parking lots). City officials are expected at this event; Deployment of
  meridian barriers are required for the area being used for this ceremony for the safety of
  the pedestrian’s attending; TCO and Security personnel check in with the Event Organizer
  / Applicants prior to the event start time to discuss any public safety / parking protocol, 100-
  150 expected to attend;The applicant will have large work trucks parked on the east service
  road of Crenshaw Blvd., between 116 and 119. All visitors will be parking in the parking lot
  where the vent is to take place; None conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene,
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426767)

Item #3:  Ms. Lewis on behalf of ICEF Inglewood Elementary Charter School to host an ICEF
  Inglewood 2026 Culmination Event at 700 Warren Ln, Edward Vincent Jr. Park; Public
  Property; on Wednesday, June 03, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject to
  Parks and Rec approval for use of the park. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. IPD
  will deploy one (1) sgt and two (2) police officers for public safety and four (4) CH security
  officers to assist IPD with any potential crowd control and monitor restrooms used by
  attendees to mitigate any outside lewd conduct activity. None conditons for Code Approval;
  None conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned
  correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426709)

2026 - New Business License Request (s):
Item #4:  Jose Camarena on behalf of Prize Motorz to operate as a Used Car Dealership Business
  at 10220 Hawthorne Blvd., APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license fee and taxes; An
  expired or lapsed license for more than six months will negatively impact your license
  renewal; Parking, repairs and/or maintenance on city streets, sidewalks, or alleys of any
  vehicles for sale is strictly prohibited and violators will be cited and towed at owners
  expense; Applicant and all employees must have a valid ID and DMV / Dealer licenses if
  applicable; Subject to inspection by any Code Enforcement Officer or Police Officer;
  Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations (including

  noise and signage) Local, State and Federal Laws. Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00407167)

Item #5:  Tymur Dubachynski on behalf of Rydex Auto to operate as a Rental/Sales Dealership at
  800 S. La Brea Ave.; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six months will negatively impact your license renewal; All vehicles
  must be registered with DMV; NO parking of any vehicles, vehicle repairs / maintenance
  on any city streets, sidewalks or alleys; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off
  site at all times; Business owner and all employees shall have a valid and current
  government-issued identification in their possession at all times; Subject to random
  inspections by any City of Inglewood Code Enforcement or Police Officer or DMV
  Investigators at any time to ensure compliance; and Adhere to all State, Federal and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application requests.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426585)

New Tobacco License Renewal Request (s):
Item #7:  Hanna Orshiro on behalf of Happy Time Liquor to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 730 N.
  La Brea Ave., APPROVED CONDITIONALLY This Business License has been
  APPROVED with the following condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses
  Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically;
  CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE
  OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and Federal Rules and Regulations;
  Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or 25% of total retail floor area Sales or display of
  single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes
  ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little
  Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts
  Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers,
  Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited;Tobacco or smoke shop
  retailers are required to immediately remove any Kratom related products, including
  natural Kratom and any products containing 7-OH, from store shelves and cease all
  sales;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is
  strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have
  a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display
  of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest
  illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are
  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
